name: 81211 · Buena Vista, CO
findings: ZIP 81211 (Buena Vista) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81211 (Buena Vista) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
90% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 81211 (Buena Vista) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
